name: chooser-of-the-slain
description: Chooser of the Slain: a Valkyrie judgment game for web, Steam and Google Play.

scripts.dev: pnpm content:compile --target dev-full && vite --config apps/web/vite.config.ts --mode dev-full
scripts.build:web-demo: pnpm content:compile --target web-demo && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts --mode web-demo
scripts.build:web-itch: pnpm content:compile --target web-itch && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts --mode web-itch
scripts.build:electron-demo: pnpm content:compile --target electron-demo && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts --mode electron-demo
scripts.build:electron-full: pnpm content:compile --target electron-full && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts --mode electron-full
scripts.build:android-full: pnpm content:compile --target android-full && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts --mode android-full
scripts.build:web-playtest: pnpm content:compile --target web-playtest && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts --mode web-playtest
scripts.build:dev-full: pnpm content:compile --target dev-full && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts --mode dev-full
scripts.build:all: pnpm build:web-demo && pnpm build:web-itch && pnpm build:electron-demo && pnpm build:electron-full && pnpm build:android-full && pnpm build:web-playtest && pnpm build:dev-full
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.store:capture: rm -rf dist/store && playwright test -c tools/store-capture/playwright.config.ts && tsx tools/store-capture/finish.ts
scripts.store:check: rm -rf dist/store-check && STORE_CHECK=1 playwright test -c tools/store-capture/playwright.config.ts && STORE_CHECK=1 tsx tools/store-capture/finish.ts
